description: Monitor a real cron job or scheduled task in Epure. Create a heartbeat monitor with schedule, timezone, grace margin and runtime limits; send real check-ins from the job.

project_id.description: Epure project UUID; obtain it with epure_projects_list.

schedule.description: Cron expression, for example 0 * * * * for every hour.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/Paris; use UTC when appropriate.
